dedupe_keys.name: usgs list of agencies operating continuous gnss sites

description: This USGS page lists the agencies that operate continuous (permanent) GNSS sites whose positioning and time-series results USGS displays on its website or uses for reference frame adjustments. Contents: an alphabetical list of operating organisations compiled from site logs, RINEX headers and metadata on each network's web page, including national agencies (Agenzia Spaziale Italiana, Badan Koordinasi Survei dan Pemetaan Nasional of Indonesia, the Austrian Federal Office of Metrology and Surveying, BKG in Germany, CNES in France, China Geo-informatics Center, CICESE in Mexico) and US state, city, university and company operators such as the Arkansas highway department, the City of Mountain Home, Caltech, Central Washington University and Condor Earth Technology. Producer: the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program, which monitors earthquakes and their hazards. Coverage: networks worldwide feeding USGS GNSS products. Access: a public web page listing organisations; it links to network pages, not data files. Licence and cost: free; no licence stated. Caveats: it is a directory of operators, not a station list, and site counts and data formats must be taken from each network. Simulation uses: it identifies the open GNSS reference networks that can be used for positioning, timing and deformation monitoring of infrastructure. Related record: the EUREF permanent GNSS network (data-euref-permanent-gnss-network).
